GTA 6 Launch Expected to Strain Global Internet Bandwidth

The upcoming launch of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is anticipated to place significant strain on global internet bandwidth, according to reports. Internet service providers have reportedly sounded alarms regarding the potential impact on network infrastructure as gamers worldwide prepare to access the highly anticipated title.
